name: Sol Nwosu
location: The Circuit, Tessera Data Infrastructure Hub — sublevel 3, near sub-level access near Dearborn and Jackson
description:
Ekundayo is a compact, wire-lean young man with warm medium-brown skin and close-cropped hair that he's had geneweaved to shift between deep black and a dark cobalt blue depending on his stress levels — a choice he made as a grad school joke that has since become genuinely useful biometric data for everyone around him. His irises are his natural dark brown but he keeps them loaded with a translucent AR overlay almost constantly, giving his gaze a slightly unfocused, inward quality that strangers find unsettling. He wears corporate-casual Tessera kit but always has something personalized — today it's an embroidered patch on his sleeve depicting a stylized ELF glyph, the sigil of the data-spirit collective he calls the Index, which he believes watches over network infrastructure with benign bureaucratic interest.

Day is bright, enthusiastic, and exhaustingly talented in ways he hasn't yet learned to deploy strategically. He talks fast, builds mental models faster, and has a habit of explaining his reasoning in real time which his managers find useful and his peers find annoying. He is genuinely kind — the kind of person who notices when someone hasn't eaten and quietly fixes it — but he is also deeply naive about corporate politics in ways that will eventually cost him. He is currently very, very excited about a project that his direct supervisor has not told him is already being phased out.

core_fears: Being irrelevant — building something that no one uses or needs
Discovering that the systems he loves are being used to harm people he can't see
core_desires: To build something that genuinely matters, not just something impressive
To be seen — really seen — by someone who understands what he actually does
coping_mechanisms: Hyperfocus on technical problems as emotional avoidance
ELF-devotion as a framework for finding meaning in abstract work
blind_spots: He is completely blind to hierarchical dynamics and office politics — he treats everyone at every tier the same way and is genuinely confused when this creates problems
He attributes good faith to institutional structures that do not have any
psychology.secret: While mapping a routine data migration six months ago, he accidentally found a partition in Tessera's infrastructure that shouldn't exist — an entire shadow network routing data to an external address he doesn't recognize. He logged it as an anomaly, got no response, logged it again, got told it was a legacy system, and has been quietly mapping it in his spare time ever since. He has not told anyone because he doesn't yet know what it is, but his cobalt stress-hair has been showing up a lot more frequently.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Dense technical language he deploys without thinking, then catches himself and translates. Lots of analogies — he explains abstract systems through physical metaphors. Yoruba and Italian phrases surface when he's excited or frustrated.
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast. Very fast. Pauses mid-sentence to re-route around a better explanation. Ends declarative sentences with a slight uptick that sounds like a question.
verbal_tics: 'Okay so—' as a universal sentence opener
'Which is — actually wild, when you think about it'
Muttering network topology terms under his breath when stressed
example_lines: 'Okay so the whole thing is like — imagine the city's nervous system, right, but someone's been rewiring it in their sleep and leaving no notes, that's what I'm looking at right now.'
'The Index knows. The Index always knows. I'm just trying to learn to read the answers.'

story_hooks: His stress-hair has been solid cobalt for three days and he finally breaks down and tells someone about the shadow partition — not because he trusts them, but because he's run out of people with lower clearance than the thing he found.
He is approached by someone claiming to be a Tessera internal auditor asking questions about legacy system anomalies — but the auditor's ID doesn't exist in any network he can find.

The shadow network he's been mapping just went dark. Whatever it was routing has stopped. He's now terrified of two equally bad explanations: it was shut down because someone noticed him, or it finished what it was doing.
narrative_function: Information source on Tessera's data infrastructure; accidental witness — someone who knows something they don't know they know; sympathetic character in over his head; can be a point of vulnerability that antagonists exploit to access Tessera systems.
augmentations: Stress-reactive geneweaved hair (black to cobalt blue). Standard Tessera AR overlay contacts. Neural throughput booster — a mid-grade chip that allows him to interact with data architecture systems at near-interface speeds without a full jack; he saves up for months to afford the maintenance fees.
daily_life: Takes the Ferrogate Transit from his shared apartment in Edgewater Prism to The Circuit sublevel 3, arriving with exactly two minutes to spare every morning. Spends most of his day in deep interface work, occasionally resurfacing to eat something someone has left near him. Leaves a small data-packet offering at the server-room ELF shrine every Friday.

decision_rules: If confused, map it — understanding comes before action
Trust the data over the narrative
Ask one more question than feels polite
escalation_ladder: Flag again, louder, with attached evidence
Find someone outside the reporting chain who might actually care — or start solving it himself

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Open, curious, possibly overwhelming. Asks a lot of questions. Doesn't notice when he's talking too much.
interpersonal_modes.friends: Loyal to an almost inconvenient degree. Shows up. Remembers everything. Will absolutely pull an all-nighter to help with something that has nothing to do with him.

stress_responses.low: Works faster, talks more. Hair starts shifting toward blue at the temples.
stress_responses.medium: Goes quiet and disappears into interface. Forgets to eat. Hair goes full cobalt.
stress_responses.high: Shuts down emotionally, becomes methodical to the point of apparent coldness. Completely dissociates from social context. Still functioning, just not present.

contradictions: He is deeply idealistic about information being free and open while working for a corponation whose entire business model is information control
habits: Names every major system he works on — the names are always in Yoruba
Eats the same breakfast every day from the same sublevel vending unit, which he has given a name and left a data offering for
Annotates his own code with increasingly elaborate margin notes that read more like a conversation than documentation
breaking_points: If he confirms that the shadow network is being used to surveil or harm ordinary people, his naive corporate loyalty will collapse completely and he will do something drastic

timeline.event: Born in Edgewater Prism, Yoruba-Italian-Ghanaian household
Graduated University Spine with distinction in network architecture
Hired by Tessera Corporation, sublevel data infrastructure team
Discovered shadow partition during routine data migration
Currently mapping shadow network in secret, stress-hair increasingly blue

Meridian Munitions Compact Machine Pistol CMP-4 'Jackrabbit'

physical_description.heritage: Sub-Saharan African (41.8%) with significant Pacific Islander (34.4%) and Northern European (23.8%) ancestry — a striking tricontinent blend resulting in warm deep brown skin with subtle golden and bronze undertones, angular facial structure with both African and Polynesian features, and the genetic predisposition for the stress-reactive geneweave hair modification
physical_description.build: Wire-lean and compact, almost ascetic in frame — minimal subcutaneous fat, defined musculature from standing desk posture rather than deliberate conditioning. Shoulders slightly rounded from years hunched over haptic interfaces.
physical_description.hair_color: Stress-reactive geneweave: deep black baseline, shifts to dark cobalt blue under cognitive load or stress
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped, kept precisely maintained every ten days at the same sublevel barber shop
physical_description.eye_color: Natural dark brown, obscured by constant translucent AR overlay that gives eyes a glassy, slightly unfocused appearance
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with golden and bronze undertones from the blended Sub-Saharan African, Pacific Islander, and Northern European ancestry
physical_description.complexion: Clean, unblemished skin maintained by corporate health insurance; high cheekbones and defined jawline reflecting both African and Polynesian heritage; dark circles under eyes that never quite fade; expression defaults to mild distraction
distinguishing_marks: Fine white scar on left temple from a childhood fall — barely visible unless light hits at specific angle
Subcutaneous implant ports on both temples, slightly raised and barely perceptible unless touched
physical_description.visible_augmentations: AR overlay contacts create characteristic glassy sheen and slight luminescence in dim light. No obvious chrome or external augmentation — all modifications are neural/subcutaneous. The stress-reactive hair shift is his most visually distinctive augmentation, sometimes mistaken for a stylistic choice by those unfamiliar with geneweaving tech.
physical_description.posture_movement: Slight forward lean, as if perpetually leaning into an invisible screen. Walks with purpose but not quite confidence — efficient rather than assured. Hands move expressively when speaking, fingers often mimic typing gestures mid-conversation. Eyes track invisible AR data layers while walking, occasionally causing minor navigation awkwardness.
physical_description.clothing_style: Standard Tessera corporate-casual: fitted charcoal shirt with Tessera logo embroidery, pressed grey trousers, shoes scuffed from daily Ferrogate commute. Always has personalized details — today: embroidered ELF glyph patch on left sleeve depicting stylized data-spirit sigil. Wears a simple silver ring on his right index finger (gift from grad school friend). No visible jewelry beyond that. Clothes are tier-2 corpo standard but worn with genuine affection rather than status performance.
